lines.text: Tower to all units. We have a cancellation. Two o'clock slot, grooming table one. Slot is now open.
Scanning the waitlist. Biscuit, the golden doodle, three blocks out. Biscuit, you are cleared for the two o'clock. Text sent.
A spot opened up? Biscuit, get your leash! We'll be there in ten!
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Cancellations get filled from your waitlist in about a minute. Built right here in Southwestern Ontario. Comment MAP and I'll show you how. You're still the captain.
